title: Docker Compose — Workflows
description: Docker Compose × Workflows integration. Owns the workflows service overlays (deploy/compose/compose.workflows.yaml and compose.workflows.dev.yaml) and their defaults environment (workflows.defaults.env) that the Compose roots include when the durable worker is deployed with Compose. Hidden: it activates automatically when both docker-compose and workflows are effective, and selecting it directly is shorthand for that pair. Template-only; delivered through the Git source.
